versions.name: RXV2-0.9.660-two-wires-card
versions.notes: Before you start opens with 'First, get a short USB-C data cable': connect both wires - the lead flies and carries the everyday pages, the USB cable is the configurator's own channel (every setting, Ports, In-flight adjustments, command line, factory reset, black box); about 12 cm, right-angled if possible, must carry data. Without it the computer does the port/CRSF/telemetry and the USB-only pages stay out of reach. Includes 0.9.659.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.659-usb-first-time
versions.notes: Before you start: a computer only to flash the firmware; with the USB cable the Ports page does the rest - choosing 'receiver' for a port now also switches on serial receiver mode and telemetry (features 3 + 10, read-modify-write) in the same Save, so a brand-new flight controller never needs the configurator's Receiver tab. Configurator steps kept as the no-cable alternative. New-heli wizard step reworded. Includes 0.9.658.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.658-help-corner
versions.notes: The ? and search circles sit 2.6em further in from the top-right corner, clear of the app's small X on the demo and review screens (iPad mis-taps). Includes 0.9.657.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.657-cable
versions.notes: Help (Rotorflight menu, Setup's USB socket, every Ways-to-connect footer): buy a SHORT USB-C cable, about 12 cm, right-angled at the flight controller if you can, and make sure it is a data cable - many short leads only charge. Includes 0.9.656.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.656-two-wires
versions.notes: Help: 'Two wires, everything' - the receiver lead carries flying and the everyday pages; the USB-C cable adds the configurator's own channel (every setting, any size, command line, ports, factory reset, black box); a transmitter's Lua scripts have only the slow 320-byte CRSF tunnel. Said on the Rotorflight menu help and in every help screen's Ways to connect, which no longer calls the app Apple-only. Includes 0.9.655.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.655-filters
versions.notes: New Filters page (Rotorflight's Filters tab): gyro lowpass 1 and 2 (type and cutoff), rotor-speed (RPM) notch preset and lowest frequency, dynamic notches (count, width, range) and the two fixed notches; read-modify-write of MSP 92/93, takes effect at once. The help explains what each filter does and how to read the Blackbox Explorer's frequency view to see which filter is needed. Includes 0.9.654.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.654-review-fixes
versions.notes: From a critical pass over the day's work: In-flight adjustments never switches flight-controller banks while the transmitter is on (the boxes fill only for the bank in use; flip the switch for another); a Remove whose save fails reloads the page from the flight controller and says 'Not removed'; Save shows 'Writing line N of 43'; a receiver whose line to the flight controller carries no MSP (SBUS, IBUS, PPM, or FC telemetry off) answers 'needs the USB cable' instead of a timeout; the Ports warning covers the dongle's own port. Includes 0.9.653.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.653-recording-banner
versions.notes: A replayed recording (Review: <model> in the app's list) now says so at the top of every page: 'Recording of <model> - nothing here is live. To connect, use Load another model on the front page.' Includes 0.9.652.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.652-greyed-darker
versions.notes: Greyed (read-only) controls on In-flight adjustments and the Command line stay readable: dark text at 80 percent instead of 45. Includes 0.9.651.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.651-adj-offline-copy
versions.notes: In-flight adjustments: without the USB cable the page shows the set it last read over USB (kept per model on the phone), greyed and not changeable, with the time it was read; the live switch marker still moves over the radio link. Includes 0.9.650.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.650-back-scroll
versions.notes: Back returns to where you were: a long list (A la carte, Find a setting, any page) remembers its scroll position when you leave it and puts it back when you come back by the back arrow or a back gesture. A fresh visit still starts at the top. Includes 0.9.649.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.649-alacarte-order
versions.notes: A la carte: In-flight adjustments sits in its alphabetical place (after Governor). Includes 0.9.648.
